{{Top|leg}}
The '''binary nebula''' was a track configuration used during [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]]. A twisting course, it was lined by [[repulsor buoy]]s that would fire [[ion flare]]s during the race. The resulting ion particles would cause unpredictable malfunctions in the control or drive systems of any [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] that could not avoid the sparks.
